The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4acb0e456988f38e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 57. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Along any fixed sequence of optimizers with the strong-removal hypotheses above and fixed outer-comparability constants, the following estimate holds for targets i with cw ≤ vi ≤ Cw and ri ≤ Cw, |Si − Γb K (c Ki)| w3 ≤ C′ {εm + (Di/w)ϑ }, εm −→ 0, ϑ > 0. (7.1) The constants and modulus are common to the fixed target band. Thus this difference is O(w3) throughout the band, and is o(w3) along any moving target with Di = o(w). Since the target-band integrals of D2 are o(w3), the same modulus gives, separately in the two coordinates, 1 w Z |Si − Γb K (c Ki)| w3 dvi = o(1), 1 w Z |Sα(r) − Γb K (c Kα(r))| w3 dr = o(1). (7.2) Each integral is restricted to the target band just described.
